Graduate Program
In coordination with D-MATH and I-MATH, ZGSM offers a broad graduate program in mathematics and its applications, consisting of graduate courses, workshops, and retreats.
Current and past programs can be found at Graduate Courses, Colloquia & Research Seminars , and Retreats.
Research areas covered by current graduate faculty:
Algebra, Algebraic Geometry, Analysis and PDE, Combinatorics and Optimization, Coding Theory and Cryptography, Discrete Mathematics, Geometry, Groups and Dynamics, Insurance Mathematics, Mathematical Finance, Mathematical Physics, Number Theory, Numerical Analysis, Operation Research, Probability Theory, Scientifc Computing, Statistics, Symplectic Geometry, Topology
Details can be found at
